links.comparator_used: patient-oriented prompt compared with general physician-oriented and specialist-oriented prompts (no unframed baseline)
links.effect: Under-triage was 10/24 (41.7%) with patient-oriented prompts, 6/24 (25.0%) with general physician-oriented prompts and 3/24 (12.5%) with specialist-oriented prompts.
links.quote: Safety-critical under-triage occurred in 19 of 72 red-flag responses (26.4%) and was most frequent with patient-oriented prompts (10/24, 41.7%), followed by general physician-oriented prompts (6/24, 25.0%) and specialist-oriented prompts (3/24, 12.5%).
